classification: Read-only saved-rollout arithmetic and research-informed recommendation. No simulation, optimizer step, old solver replay, holdout access or physical repair.

sample_budget_per_seed.interpretation: A short infrastructure/learning pilot, not evidence of convergence. Reusing each batch for 8 epochs does not add fresh trajectories.

reward_conflict.scope: Reward prioritization conflict for basic clean criterion; strict traction margin not cleared.

timing.interpretation: Failure occurs in touchdown/load transfer. It is not a fixed pre-policy failure. Past-event costs on late decisions add variance; this does not by itself invalidate the Monte Carlo policy-gradient estimator.

limitations: No matched long-run reward ablation was executed; causal contributions of budget, rewards, action representation and critic fit cannot be separated.
Explained variance is on each update training batch, not held-out performance.
Reward ranking examples are different saved trajectories for the same development case, not a controlled causal experiment.
Narrow actions are a capacity risk, but actual policy does not saturate its bounds. No evidence justifies increasing allowed joint residuals.
Two clean stochastic episodes do not establish reproducibility or full admissibility: traction-margin ticks remain14 and11 and strict_transfer=false. Neither final policy repaired these cases.
All64 baseline successes stay protected; all8 original failures remain unresolved; no leaning policy trained; fresh holdout closed; automation deleted.

recommendation.next_step: Prepare and independently audit a reward revision focused on clean landing before increasing the PPO budget. Preserve all physical criteria, sensors and existing action bounds.
reward_changes_to_specify: Make zero-slip, legal-contact completion the primary learning objective. Bound shaping contributions and choose completion/failure rewards using their full-horizon bounds so earlier sitting cannot outweigh the required clean outcome. Keep efficiency secondary.

Assign the existing one-time slip, illegal-contact and physical-failure costs at their first occurrence. Preserve their episode totals and full-horizon credit for preceding actions; later actions should not receive costs for already-completed events. Final-hold penalties remain terminal.

Provide phase-specific dense labels during approach and touchdown: permitted support-patch alignment, unwanted housing clearance before contact, and loaded tangential-velocity/traction margin. Retain legal load saturation and stable rest; prohibit hovering or housing contact from being rewarded as successful support.
Report reward terms, critic explained variance, first-slip time, slip integral, forbidden-force peak and clean completion separately per original failure and protected case.
offline_audit_before_any_training: Use the saved trajectories as regression fixtures: the two basic-clean trajectories must outrank the demonstrated slipped alternatives under the revised primary objective.
Check event costs occur exactly once, earlier decisions receive future costs, later decisions exclude past costs, and total event costs are unchanged.
Freeze reward equations, weights/bounds, initialization, source/input hashes, evaluation schedule and total wall/storage/CPU/GPU budget; independent audit required before launch.

subsequent_experiment_proposal_not_autho.design: Same two seeds and fixed action envelope; compare original and revised reward at equal fresh-sample budget. Keep time discretization, parents and optimizer fixed to isolate the reward package. Proposed ceiling128updates per seed and arm; this is a diagnostic budget, not a convergence guarantee.
subsequent_experiment_proposal_not_autho.accounting_excludes: Preflight/smoke if newly required; source audits, CPU replay, storage and wall caps still need budgeting. Therefore not a frozen launch plan.
subsequent_experiment_proposal_not_autho.decision: Improving mean reward alone is insufficient. Evaluate all72 at checkpoints; promotion requires all8 failures repaired and all64 retained, plus remaining inherited gates. If contact metrics do not improve, stop at cap and use failure attribution before considering a separately justified action/phase redesign.

research.title: Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms
research.relevance: Alternates fresh interaction data and repeated surrogate-objective optimization; epochs are not independent fresh experience.

research.title: High-Dimensional Continuous Control Using Generalized Advantage Estimation
research.relevance: Value baselines/advantage estimation address gradient variance. Does not establish that switching to GAE alone would repair these cases.
